stepMarkerYawOffsetDeg.uiInfo: {"hint":"Spin the step markers by this many degrees if they point the wrong way (try 180)."}

stopLabelWearerOffsetMeters.uiInfo: {"hint":"Once the wearer is standing on the sign the label slides this far out in front of them, in arena-metres, so the countdown isn't sitting on their nose. It returns over the sign when they step off. 0 = always stay over the sign."}

arenaIdLabel.uiInfo: {"hint":"Screen-space Text (top-right corner) that shows the active arena_id, dashed for the wearer, e.g. 0000-1000. Use the Zilla Slab font. The Edit button (ArenaIdEditorTyped) changes which arena_id this points at."}

stepMarkerSizeMeters.uiInfo: {"hint":"Size of the step markers at 100%, in arena-metres."}

stepMarkerPrefab.uiInfo: {"hint":"Marker dropped where the NEXT footfall is predicted to land. Leave EMPTY to reuse wearerDotPrefab, so one prefab covers the wearer's dot and all four step markers. Step prediction is off only if BOTH this and wearerDotPrefab are empty."}

stepCadenceSeconds.uiInfo: {"hint":"Seconds per step to assume until enough footfalls have been timed to measure the real cadence. ~0.55 is an ordinary walking pace."}

numberTagFaceCamera.uiInfo: {"hint":"Keep each number turned toward the wearer (yaw only, stays upright). Off = the number faces into the arena."}

startLinePrefab.uiInfo: {"hint":"FBX prefab for the START line. Import startline.fbx, make a prefab, drag it here. Placed on the floor like any obstacle."}

stepMarkerFourthPrefab.uiInfo: {"hint":"Marker for the 4th step ahead. Empty = reuse the 1st marker's prefab. This one lands about two seconds out, so it swings wide whenever the wearer turns."}

startFinishLineExtraScale.uiInfo: {"hint":"Extra size multiplier applied ONLY to the start/finish line prefabs, on top of their own baked-in scale and obstacleBaseScale/arenaScale. Bump this up if the lines still look too small."}

snapshotCoalesceSeconds.uiInfo: {"hint":"Wait this long before actually asking the server for fresh tables, so a burst of triggers (open, start, retrieve, reload) becomes ONE pull instead of four. 0.25-0.5 is right; 0 restores the old behaviour."}

stepBobThresholdCm.uiInfo: {"hint":"How deep a dip must be, from the head's high point down to its low point, to count as a footfall — in centimetres. Walking bobs the head roughly 1-2cm each step. Raise this if markers fire while standing, lower it if slow walking is missed."}

stopLabelFont.uiInfo: {"hint":"Font for the floating STOP / countdown label. Normally the same Zilla Slab font as the number tags — leave empty to reuse numberTagFont."}

autoStartArenaOnConnect.uiInfo: {"hint":"Generate a new arena automatically the first time the glasses connect, so the arena code fills in without needing a Start button wired. Turn off to drive it only from the Start button."}

numberTagFloatAmplitudeMeters.uiInfo: {"hint":"How far the number bobs up and down, in arena-metres, from its resting height. 0 = no float."}

pathTriangleYellowPrefab.uiInfo: {"hint":"Prefab for YELLOW path points (Paths.color = 'yellow'). Must be its OWN prefab with a yellow material — not a renamed copy of the blue one."}

pathTriangleRedPrefab.uiInfo: {"hint":"Prefab for RED path points (Paths.color = 'red'). Must be its OWN prefab with a red material — not a renamed copy of the blue one."}

pathTriangleGreenPrefab.uiInfo: {"hint":"Prefab for GREEN path points (Paths.color = 'green'). Must be its OWN prefab with a green material — not a renamed copy of the blue one."}

pathColorNames.uiInfo: {"hint":"Extra Paths.color values from the DB, e.g. purple, orange. Case-insensitive. Leave empty unless the website has gained new swatches."}

stopLabelText.uiInfo: {"hint":"What the label reads before the wearer steps on the sign."}

stopGoText.uiInfo: {"hint":"What the label reads once the hold is complete."}

pathTrianglePrefab.uiInfo: {"hint":"Prefab for BLUE path points (Paths.color = 'blue'). Also the FALLBACK for any colour with no prefab of its own."}

numberTagScale.uiInfo: {"hint":"Overall size multiplier for the floating number. Increase if the digits read too small. NUMBER_TAG_EXTRA_SCALE multiplies this again."}

stepVelocitySmoothingSeconds.uiInfo: {"hint":"Smoothing in seconds on the wearer's velocity. Higher = steadier markers but slower to swing round when they turn."}

numberTagYawOffsetDeg.uiInfo: {"hint":"Spin the number by this many degrees if it ends up facing away from you (try 180)."}

pathColorPrefabs.uiInfo: {"hint":"Prefabs matching pathColorNames 1:1 — same order, same length."}

finishLinePrefab.uiInfo: {"hint":"FBX prefab for the FINISH line. Import finishline.fbx, make a prefab, drag it here. Placed on the floor like any obstacle."}

numberTagHeightMeters.uiInfo: {"hint":"How high the number floats off the floor, in arena-metres. ~1.5 ≈ eye / sight level at full arenaScale. NUMBER_TAG_EXTRA_LIFT_M is added on top of this."}

numberTagFloatSpeed.uiInfo: {"hint":"How fast the number bobs up and down, in cycles per second."}

numberTagFont.uiInfo: {"hint":"Zilla Slab font asset. Import ZillaSlab-Bold.ttf into Assets, then drag the Font asset here."}

reconnectMaxSeconds.uiInfo: {"hint":"Longest the reconnect wait is allowed to grow to, in seconds."}

stepMarkerSecondPrefab.uiInfo: {"hint":"Marker for the 2nd step ahead. Empty = reuse the 1st marker's prefab."}

stopLabelScale.uiInfo: {"hint":"Overall size multiplier for the STOP / countdown label."}

stepMarkerThirdPrefab.uiInfo: {"hint":"Marker for the 3rd step ahead. Empty = reuse the 1st marker's prefab. Colouring the four differently (e.g. green/yellow/orange/red) reads as how far ahead each guess is — and how much less each is worth trusting."}

connectionLabel.uiInfo: {"hint":"OPTIONAL screen-space Text showing the link state (CONNECTING / LIVE / OFFLINE). Worth wiring: on a slow network the difference between 'still loading' and 'broken' is the whole of the user's experience."}

wearerDotSmoothing.uiInfo: {"hint":"Smoothing in seconds for the dot's slide. Head tracking sways even when you stand still, and a dot copying that exactly looks nervous. ~0.1 settles it without feeling laggy; 0 = glued exactly under the head."}

connectTimeoutSeconds.uiInfo: {"hint":"Give up on a connection attempt that hasn't opened after this many seconds and start a fresh one. On a slow network a socket can sit half-open forever; without this the Lens waits with it."}

stopLabelHeightMeters.uiInfo: {"hint":"How high the STOP label floats off the floor, in arena-metres. Match numberTagHeightMeters to keep it at the same eye level as the numbers."}

reconnectBaseSeconds.uiInfo: {"hint":"First reconnect wait, in seconds. Each further failure doubles it (with jitter) up to the maximum below, so a server that is down doesn't get hammered every 3s by every pair of glasses in the room."}

samplesToLock.uiInfo: {"hint":"AUTO: how many steady floor hits in a row before locking. ~10–30. Higher = steadier but slower."}

placeInFrontCm.uiInfo: {"hint":"AUTO: on the first real lock, also slide the arena this many cm in front of you. 0 = leave X/Z where it is."}

autoDetectFloor.uiInfo: {"hint":"ON (recommended): assume a floor below you instantly, then refine to the real floor by looking at it. OFF: classic aim-and-pinch placement."}

groundOnly.uiInfo: {"hint":"Only lock onto HORIZONTAL surfaces (real floor), ignoring walls/tilted surfaces."}

camera.uiInfo: {"hint":"The device Camera object (the wearer's head). Required: gaze + height come from this."}

driftThresholdCm.uiInfo: {"hint":"AUTO + continuousTracking: re-level only if the floor moves more than this many cm from the locked height."}

assumedCameraHeightCm.uiInfo: {"hint":"Assumed distance from your eyes down to the floor, in cm. Used instantly and as the editor/fallback floor (~100–120 for a standing adult)."}

stabilityToleranceCm.uiInfo: {"hint":"AUTO: the floor hit must stay within this many cm to count as 'steady'."}

continuousTracking.uiInfo: {"hint":"AUTO: keep watching after locking and re-level if the floor drifts beyond the threshold below. OFF = lock once and stay put."}

matchFloorHeightOnly.uiInfo: {"hint":"MANUAL mode only. ON: keep the arena X/Z and just drop it to floor height. OFF: move the whole arena to where you pinch."}

reticle.uiInfo: {"hint":"Optional marker shown at the floor spot you're aiming at while it calibrates."}

maxFloorDistanceCm.uiInfo: {"hint":"AUTO: how far along your gaze to search for the floor, in cm. 1000 = up to 10 m."}

arenaRoot.uiInfo: {"hint":"The object to pin to the floor — your ArenaRoot."}

recenterToHit.uiInfo: {"hint":"ON: move the arena to where you looked. OFF: keep the arena's X/Z and only drop it to floor height."}

visualObj.uiInfo: {"hint":"Scene object moved to the detected surface position during calibration (the ring)"}

camObj.uiInfo: {"hint":"Camera scene object whose forward direction defines the hit-test ray"}

arenaRoot.uiInfo: {"hint":"Your ArenaRoot — dropped onto the detected floor when calibration completes."}

autoStart.uiInfo: {"hint":"Start floor calibration automatically when the lens starts."}

assumedCameraHeightCm.uiInfo: {"hint":"Assumed eye-to-floor height (cm), applied instantly so the arena sits on the floor even before/without a real scan (e.g. in the editor)."}

calRenderer.uiInfo: {"hint":"RenderMeshVisual whose material parameters are animated during calibration"}
